prompt: Write 10 distinct notes the mortgage-underwriting agent (residential mortgage applications and remortgages) at Larkmere Mutual made about one member each while helping them with: energy bills squeezing the budget. Each says what will help the next time this agent serves this member: how they like to be dealt with, what is still open, what to check. One or two sentences, third person, no names. This batch leans towards younger members renting or buying their first home. Return {"items": [{"type": "fact" | "preference" | "observation", "content": "..."}]} with exactly 10 items. (batch 0)
